name: Uthros Combine
description: A rival research outfit whose secret facility in the core of Uthros is thought to hold something big.

description_citations.work: Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros
description_citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros" by AnaMaria Curtis. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Velmenon explains that Solidbodies is behind its rival the Uthros Combine and offers Geldan freedom from her debt if she gets into the Uthros facility.
timeline.quote: If you can get in, you will be free.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros" by AnaMaria Curtis. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: They land on the research base at the core, where the crushing pressure presses on Geldan despite her suit.
timeline.quote: Geldan feels pressure bear down on her like the palm of a giant hand, inexorable and grinding and cruel.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros" by AnaMaria Curtis. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Mm'menon explains they were expelled from the Uthros Combine and deduced a causality manipulator.
timeline.quote: I was thrown out of the Uthros Combine

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Mm'menon, expelled from the Uthros Combine, lent services to Tezzeret to stay in-system.
timeline.quote: After being expelled from the Combine, Mm'menon lent their services to Tezzeret to stay in-system

citation.work: The Legends of Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "The Legends of Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Amanda LaFranco, Laurel Pratt, Jay Annelli. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vv'viza takes over leadership of the Uthros Combine after Mm'menon's flight.
timeline.quote: Vv'viza eagerly stepped up to fill the void of leadership left in their absence.

citation.work: The Legends of Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "The Legends of Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Amanda LaFranco, Laurel Pratt, Jay Annelli. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2025.

relations.note: Solidbodies is a rival of the Uthros Combine and wants to learn its secret.
relations.quote: Our research and development teams are being outflanked by those gas-for-brains at the Uthros Combine.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | The Doors of Uthros" by AnaMaria Curtis. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

relations.note: Mm'menon is a disgraced former researcher of the Combine.
relations.quote: Mm'menon is a disgraced former researcher of the Uthros Combine

citation.text: "The Legends of Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Amanda LaFranco, Laurel Pratt, Jay Annelli. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2025.
